correctness.rationale: The proof is exact. The Walsh samples equal, up to global reversal, all signed sums of four planar unit coefficient vectors. Their convex hull is a four-generator zonogon with perimeter \(16\) and at most eight vertices. The sharp perimeter bound inside a radius-\(R\) disk forces \(R\ge\csc(\pi/8)\), and equality forces a regular octagon. Zonogon edge directions then give the iff phase classification. The verifier checks the explicit equality case exactly but is not used as an infinite or exhaustive proof.
